role: post-result descriptive audit; cannot change H1-H6 verdicts
question: After positive, perfect-negative and temporal evidence, which BAM axes remain variable among compatible worlds?
interpretation_rule: An axis is unresolved when more than one value of that declared axis remains among worlds compatible with the same truth evidence. This is a decomposition ambiguity, not parameter-estimation uncertainty.
forbidden: reinterpret audit as a new confirmatory test
